finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts::one unreachable image aborts the entire pptx export, unlike the pdf path which degrades gracefully
evidence: Verified in the supplied sources: `exportSlidesPptxAndDownload`'s `fetchImage` adapter calls `docsImageFetcher(src)` with no error handling (pptx-actions.ts, the `fetchImage` arrow near the end of the file), `docsImageFetcher` throws `Image fetch failed: …` on any non-ok response (docs/export-utils.ts), and `exportPptx`'s Step-2 pre-scan awaits `opts.fetchImage(src)` un-guarded inside the `for (const src of allImageSrcs)` loop (packages/slides/src/export/pptx/index.ts), so a single rejection aborts the whole archive build and surfaces as the generic "Export failed" toast from `runExport`. The contrast with the PDF path is also accurate: `resolveDeckImages` in packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts wraps each `fetcher(src)` in try/catch and substitutes `BLANK_PNG`. Impact is limited to decks containing an unreachable/deleted image src, but in that case PPTX export is completely blocked rather than degrading, so the inconsistency is a genuine (if edge-case) correctness/robustness gap.
